data.text: Luke, that’s generous, but if you’re willing to sit out twice, four catches of 12.5 this month and next would give each of us $25,000 over two months while keeping the lake full—better than $24,500 with a dip in stock. The extra income comes from your sacrifice, not from catching 13 now. I’d rather we use the 12.5 limit this month, then return to 10 each so you earn alongside us. With choices private, we need everyone’s commitment before counting on that plan. John, will you agree to 12.5 this month if Kate and Jack do too?
